labels.text: section 5000A(e)(1)(A): coverage is unaffordable when the required contribution exceeds 8 percent of household income

8 percent of household income (statutory base value; indexed after 2014 by the percentage the Secretary of Health and Human Services determines, (e)(1)(D) — the indexed values are not pinned, SOURCE_GAP) — IRC_S5000A_NOTE_7 (taxable years ending after Dec. 31, 2013) and the pinned 2024 text; the years 2016-2018 carry different values in the text before Pub. L. 115-97 §11081, which the pinned 2024 edition does not contain — SOURCE_GAP
